@@ -182,6 +182,77 @@ class ValidationError(Exception):
     def __repr__(self):
         return 'ValidationError(%s)' % self
 
+    def __eq__(self, other):
+        if not isinstance(other, ValidationError):
+            return True
+        return self.__class__._compare(self, other)
+
+    def __hash__(self):
+        return hash((
+            self.code,
+            self.params,
+            tuple(sorted(map(hash, self._as_hashable_messages()))),
+        ))
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _compare(cls, error1, error2):
+        """
+        Compare two ValidationError instances, ignoring the order in which
+        errors were raised (whether in a field, in a list of errors, or as
+        fields of an error dictionary).
+        """
+        if hasattr(error1, 'error_dict') != hasattr(error2, 'error_dict'):
+            return False
+        if hasattr(error1, 'error_dict'):
+            if error1.error_dict.keys() != error2.error_dict.keys():
+                return False
+            return all(
+                cls._compare_list(errors1, error2.error_dict[field])
+                for field, errors1 in error1.error_dict.items()
+            )
+        # Both errors are (possibly multi-)message errors.
+        return cls._compare_list(error1.error_list, error2.error_list)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _compare_list(cls, error_list1, error_list2):
+        """Compare two lists of errors, ignoring the ordering."""
+        if len(error_list1) != len(error_list2):
+            return False
+        remaining = list(error_list2)
+        for error1 in error_list1:
+            for i, error2 in enumerate(remaining):
+                if cls._compare(error1, error2):
+                    remaining.pop(i)
+                    break
+            else:
+                return False
+        return True
+
+    def _as_hashable_messages(self):
+        """
+        Return a flat list of the messages of this error, each rendered with
+        its params, so that identical errors hash identically regardless of
+        the order in which they were raised.
+        """
+        if hasattr(self, 'error_dict'):
+            for field, errors in self.error_dict.items():
+                yield from (
+                    (field,) + message._hashable_message()
+                    for error in errors
+                    for message in error._as_hashable_messages()
+                )
+        else:
+            for error in self.error_list:
+                yield error._hashable_message()
+
+    def _hashable_message(self):
+        """Return a hashable representation of a single message error."""
+        return (
+            self.message,
+            self.params,
+            tuple(sorted(self.params.items())) if self.params else None,
+        )
